name: Two Mornings a Day

levels.entry: The market opens twice and closes twice, and everyone knows when without being told.
It is the tide, obviously. What is less obvious is that the tide here is not the tide at Lothal.
A ledger goes back sixty years of opening times. Nobody kept it for the tide; they kept it for the tolls.
Read as a tide record it is better than anything the University has, and it says the high water is arriving later each decade.

notes: Local record-keeping outperforming the academy again, and this time entirely by accident -- the ledger was for taxes.
